name: issue-triage
description: Repeatable evidence-backed triage of this repo's open GitHub issues: batched parallel evidence-gathering, cross-batch synthesis, a claim-verification pass, and a disposition report. Report-only — executing dispositions stays a manual follow-up. The batch-evidence dispatch holds live gh credentials and unrestricted Bash with no command-level enforcement, so install at project scope only in a repo with a public GitHub issue backlog.
